name: Mechanical Hive
description: Mechanical Hivers left over from an old arms race. Cat-Lon is said to have built them to keep pace with the race experiments of the Bugmaster, and he programmed them to fill the roles of hive villages for his war. They behave so much like other Hivers that few can tell the difference. They threw off their maker and now live as any hive does, under their own Queen.
